# Ingestion, Platform Bridge & Storage Requirements Quality Checklist: Abrir Arquivo Pelo Título

**Purpose**: Validate the precision, safety, and boundary integrity of Android SAF intent handling, JNI boundaries, snapshot hashing, and Redb storage requirements
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Platform SAF & File Handling Requirements

- [x] CHK001 - Are the exact MIME filters (`text/markdown`, `text/plain`) and extensions (`.md`, `.txt`) unambiguously defined for the `ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT` intent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the maximum file size cap (93.636 bytes / `MAX_DOC_BYTES`) explicitly stated as a hard rejection threshold? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 3]
- [x] CHK003 - Does the specification define URI permission persistence (`FLAG_GRANT_PERSISTABLE_URI_PERMISSION`) to allow future re-reading without prompting? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## JNI Boundary & Snapshot Integrity

- [x] CHK004 - Is the snapshot isolation model (copying to `filesDir/snapshots/<fingerprint>.<ext>` prior to Rust handover) clearly defined? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK005 - Does the specification require Blake3-256 content hashing as the sole content addressing mechanism across JNI? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the contract for non-blocking JNI thread dispatch specified so that file reading never blocks the Android main thread? [Clarity, Gap]

## Database & Session Persistence (Redb)

- [x] CHK007 - Are the lookup and storage requirements in `redb` explicitly anchored to the document content hash rather than the file path or URI? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK008 - Does the specification define what happens to existing bookmarks when a new file has identical content but a different filename? [Edge Cases, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
